# Rein

> Rein is a risk desk for agents. You pay it to judge a yield vault. A model inside a NEAR AI Cloud TEE reads the vault's onchain state and answers HOLD, EXIT or MOVE. A NEAR contract checks the model's signature and posts the verdict to an oracle on Monad or Base. Every verdict is graded later on a public Ledger.

A verdict is advice. It is not a guarantee and it does not protect a position by itself. Browsing is free. Only `get_verdict` costs money, so call it only when you intend to pay.

## Connect

- MCP, streamable HTTP, testnet: `https://api-testnet.reinfi.xyz/mcp`
- MCP, streamable HTTP, mainnet: `https://api.reinfi.xyz/mcp`
- JSON API, testnet: `https://api-testnet.reinfi.xyz`
- JSON API, mainnet: `https://api.reinfi.xyz`
- Current status of either network: `GET /v1/health`

No key or account is needed to connect or to use the free tools.

## MCP tools

- `list_vaults`: browse vault menus, prices, spacing and next allowed times. Free.
- `latest_verdict`: read the latest public verdict for a vault. Free.
- `ledger`: read graded posts and the scoring summary. Free.
- `order_status`: read an order's status and its delivered verdict. Free.
- `get_verdict`: buy a fresh onchain verdict. On the remote server, a call without `payment` returns the x402 requirements and charges nothing.

## Paying

- x402, mainnet only: USDC from another chain through NEAR Intents, with no NEAR account. Call `get_verdict` on the remote MCP server or `POST /v1/x402/judge`. Payment settles before the judgement. If the judgement fails you get one replacement judgement, not money back.
- NEAR, testnet or mainnet: run the local MCP server from a clone with a dedicated NEAR sub-account. Payment is held in escrow and refunded in full if the post fails.
- If a result says `pending: true`, do not pay again. Repeat the call with the same payment, or call `order_status` once you have an `order_id`.

## Read without MCP

- `GET /v1/ledger`: graded posts and the Brier score.
- `GET /v1/orders/{id}`: one order with the document the model read, the model's signer and the EVM post.
- `GET /v1/orders`: recent orders.
- `GET /v1/stats`: sales and payment totals.
